title: The one problem no AI tool can solve for you
description: A new AI tool launches every day, and none of them fix the hard part: making the right call. Abz Mungul uses AI as a noise filter, an assistant that raises the signal so his decisions get sharper. Before you add another tool, ask which decision it improves. Which AI tool did you cut this month?
